{{Quote|What was he?''"<br />"''Kr'saang. He led shock troopers, as my lord knows. Specialist Unit Two Hundred Seven, in our accounting.|Daiman and Uleeta|<ref name="Knight Errant novel" />}}
'''Kr'saang''', who insisted that others refer to him as '''Kr'saang the Togorian''', was a [[Togorian/Legends|Togorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]] who led the [[Specialist Unit Two Hundred Seven]] [[Brigade/Legends|brigade]] of [[Shock trooper/Legends|shock troopers]]. In [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], he was invited alongside several other mercenaries to the [[Sanctum Celestial]] on [[Darkknell/Legends|Darkknell]] by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]], who planned to utilize them for an [[Battle of Gazzari|ambush]] on his brother [[Odion]]. However, when Kr'saang expressed anger at the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]], who preferred sabotage and ambushes over straight-up fights, Daiman swiftly sliced the Togorian into four pieces with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and then inducted Kr'saang's forces into his [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] [[Army/Legends|army]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Foolishness.''"<br />"''Then why are you here? Got to be other Sith Lords who can keep your muzzle full of chow.''"<br />"''My business. I sure know why ''you're'' here, rock-thrower. Daiman won't fight Bad Brother Odion one-on-one. He's looking for someone even more gutless to make him look good.|Kr'saang and Jarrow Rusher|<ref name="Knight Errant novel" />}}
[[File:Lord Daiman.jpg|thumb|left|Lord Damian, who killed Kr'saang]]
During the [[Republic Dark Age]],<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">The [[StarWars.com]] article [http://www.starwars.com/vault/books/knight_errant_lego/index.html Engineering with LEGOs: Creating the Ships of ''Knight Errant''] states that ''Knight Errant'' is set in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' identifies as part of the [[Republic Dark Age]].</ref> the [[Togorian/Legends|Togorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] Kr'saang led a [[Brigade/Legends|brigade]] of [[Shock trooper/Legends|shock troopers]] known as the [[Specialist Unit Two Hundred Seven]], operating from the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] ''[[Dar'oosh]]''.<ref name="Knight Errant novel" /> In 1032 BBY,<ref name="Creating the Ships of Knight Errant" /> the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]] invited Kr'saang and several other mercenaries, including [[Jarrow Rusher]] and [[Mak Medagazy]], to the [[Sanctum Celestial]] in [[Darkknell/Legends|Darkknell's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Xakrea]]. Predicting that they had been invited because Daiman was too cowardly to fight his own battles, Kr'saang pushed brutishly ahead of his fellow mercenaries to be first in line to meet Daiman.<ref name="Knight Errant novel" />

His prediction was proven correct when Daiman informed them of his plan to [[Battle of Gazzari|ambush]] his brother, [[Odion]], at the [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Gazzari]]. While the other mercenaries remained silent, Kr'saang brashly denied Daiman his services, refusing to participate in anything other than a straight-up fight. However, before Kr'saang could leave, Daiman threw his [[Cape/Legends|cape]] on the ground in front of the Togorian and charged him with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Too slow to defend himself with his blade, Kr'saang was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when Daiman cut him into four pieces. Daiman then ordered his [[Aide/Legends|aide]], [[Uleeta]], to send [[Corrector]]s&mdash;Daiman's [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]]&mdash;to induct Kr'saang's shock [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] and the ''Dar'oosh'' into his [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] [[Army/Legends|army]].<ref name="Knight Errant novel" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|What's the hurry, Tog?''"<br />"''Waste your own time, human&mdash;not mine!|Jarrow Rusher and Kr'saang|<ref name="Knight Errant novel" />}}
At two-and-a-half [[Meter/Legends|meters]], the [[Color/Legends|black]]-furred, emerald-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]] Kr'saang&mdash;who insisted on being referred to as "Kr'saang the Togorian"&mdash;was a fearsome sight, and he was well aware of it. Impatient, he was not afraid to use brute force to get what he wanted, as demonstrated when he pushed ahead of his fellow mercenaries on Darkknell to meet Daiman. Not intimidated by [[Politics/Legends|political]] power, Kr'saang brutishly defied the orders of [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Daiman, insisting he would not participate in ambushes.<ref name="Knight Errant novel" />

==Skills and abilities==
Kr'saang confidently led a shock trooper brigade and was capable of great brute force, but failed to defend himself against Daiman's lightsaber attack, which killed him.<ref name="Knight Errant novel" />

==Equipment==
Kr'saang carried a hidden [[Knife/Legends|blade]] in his [[Belt/Legends|belt]]. He also owned a [[Starship/Legends|ship]] of his own, the ''Dar’oosh''.<ref name="Knight Errant novel" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kr'saang appeared in [[John Jackson Miller]]'s [[2011]] novel, [[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']].<ref name="Knight Errant novel" />
